name: Murrieta

routes.outcome: Official City of Murrieta GIS page found; it advertises public interactive mapping and PDF map resources. It is a discovery/city GIS lead, not a verified parcel API response.
First-party Riverside County Assessor/RCIT PARCELS feature layer found. Metadata identifies polygon taxable parcels, APN as the parcel number, native WKID 102646/2230, and weekday daily updates.
Anonymous layer schema and CRS returned. Fields were inspected; only APN and geometry were used for bounded parcel requests.

Exact immutable WUP point query used geometry point [-117.149890103166,33.5360803187946] in EPSG:4326, esriGeometryPoint, esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=APN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326. It returned one polygon, APN 920090005.

Bounded nearby envelope query used [-117.1510,33.5355,-117.1488,33.5367] in EPSG:4326, esriGeometryEnvelope, outFields=APN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3. It returned three polygons: APNs 920090004, 920090005, and 920090013.

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key; APN is the native identifier exposed by the layer.

qualification.reason: A real first-party regional parcel API returned safe anonymous native IDs and polygon geometry, but adapter/runtime admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: Exact-point success is not citywide coverage evidence.
The service represents taxable parcels and may not represent every legal, recorded, condominium, or non-taxable boundary workflow.
The City of Murrieta GIS page and County Assessor service were distinguished; no separate municipal cadastral API was confirmed.
Full unchanged query responses are retained only in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/3692/.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: The public first-party layer is queryable and returned valid polygon geometry at the immutable point, but citywide completeness, publication lineage beyond the service description, and legal authority relative to recorder/title systems were not independently verified.
